name: ARA4030
title: Fonts missing or invalid
summary: The text system has no usable font: none was given, or the bytes contain no valid font face.
html:
The text system has no usable font: none was given, or the bytes contain no valid font face.

#Common causes

  • A font file is truncated or not a font.

#Fixes

  • Bundle at least one valid font with the UI; check the font pack paths.

  • Code: ARA4030

  • Constant: ui::FONT

  • Reported by: ara-ui-text
